expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Five days in two Taj hotels: two nights above the beach at Bentota with the turtle hatchery and the Madu Ganga, then two nights facing Galle Face Green in Colombo with a free day and a full day of the city.
included: Included: 4 nights in five star Taj hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a full day Bentota sightseeing tour with the Madu Ganga boat; a full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches where dinner is taken; entrance tickets where payable locally; travel insurance; spa treatments and optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
